Set up pacer

◐ Installing pacer in the background… 0:00

pacer opens in a pacer terminal tab when it is ready. Closed it? Run pacer dashboard in any terminal.

Setup not finishing? Do it by hand

Run these in any terminal:

  1. Install pacer: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamtuanvu/pacer/main/install.sh | sh
  2. Start pacer and connect your agents: ~/.local/bin/pacer init (it asks before changing any agent's files)
  3. Open the dashboard: ~/.local/bin/pacer dashboard

Already installed? Check with ~/.local/bin/pacer --version and ~/.local/bin/pacer service status.

Prefer the sidebar panel?
  1. In Orca Settings > Plugins, uninstall this pacer (installed from the marketplace).
  2. Under Development, add ~/.pacer/orca-plugin, the folder pacer init prepared for you.
  3. Enable pacer.

Orca only refreshes plugin panels added as a development folder, so the live budget panel runs from there.
